title: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini: Which One Should You Use?
hook: Three AI chatbots, but they are not all the same.

narration.text: Three AI chatbots, but they are not all the same. Picking the right one can save you a lot of time.
ChatGPT is the most versatile of the three. It handles coding, image generation, web browsing, and general tasks with a huge library of plugins and tools.
If you need an all-in-one assistant and you want the widest range of features, ChatGPT is usually the safest starting point.
Claude is the one to reach for when you need to write or analyse long documents. It tends to produce cleaner, more natural prose and handles large amounts of text very well.
If you are drafting reports, summarising research, or editing creative writing, Claude is worth trying first.
Gemini is built into Google's ecosystem, so it connects naturally with Search, Gmail, and Google Docs. That makes it useful if your work already lives inside Google's tools.
Gemini also handles multimodal tasks well, meaning it can reason across text, images, and other formats in one conversation.
All three have free tiers, and all three have paid plans that unlock more power. The best move is to try the free version of each for your specific use case.
There is no single winner. Use ChatGPT for variety, Claude for writing and long documents, and Gemini when you are deep inside Google's world.

description: ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini each have genuine strengths, and knowing which to use can make a real difference to your workflow. This video breaks down the key differences in plain language so you can pick the right tool for the job. No hype, just practical guidance.
topic: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini: which to use for what
